microsoft-password-spray.section: Password spray activity from CovertNetwork-1658 infrastructure
microsoft-password-spray.anchor: a very small number of sign-in attempts to many accounts
microsoft-password-spray.text: Microsoft Threat Intelligence reports distributed password spraying with few attempts per account across many accounts, including low-volume patterns. This is external campaign context. PurpleSharp's short multi-account failure burst can be compared with that pattern, without transferring actor identity, compromised credentials or campaign IOC conclusions to local hosts.
